verdict.rationale: Form building and validation is a fair question for a full-stack web framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions first-party form or validation modules. The closest item, Server Actions ('Run server code by calling a function'), is an adjacent primitive, not a form-building or validation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework
